title: Hybrid work
summary: How often we come in, which days are anchor days, and how to set up a good home workspace.
body:
Office-based teams work from the office at least two days a week. Tuesday and Wednesday are anchor days in Austin and Denver, when most teams meet in person.

Working from home

You can claim up to $400 every two years for home office equipment. Your manager agrees a pattern with your team and writes it down.

Plant roles

Production and quality roles at the Tulsa plant are on site.

title: Working hours and overtime
summary: Core hours, shift patterns at the plant and how overtime is approved and paid.
body:
Core hours for office staff are 10 AM to 3 PM in your local time. At the plant, first shift runs 6 AM to 2:30 PM and second shift 2:30 to 11 PM.

Overtime

Hourly employees are paid 1.5 times their rate for hours over 40 in a week. Overtime must be approved by your supervisor before the shift.

title: Your first 90 days
summary: What happens in your first week, month and quarter, and who your buddy is.
body:
Every new starter gets a buddy and a 30-60-90 day plan from their manager.

  • Week 1: laptop, accounts, the handbook and a welcome lunch.
  • Month 1: meet your department and visit the Tulsa plant (virtually if you are remote).
  • Day 90: a review with your manager on how it is going, both ways.

title: Hiring and interviewing guide
summary: For people managers: opening a role, structured interviews, scorecards and making an offer.
body:
This guide is for people managers. Every role needs an approved headcount request before it is posted.

Structured interviews

Use the same questions for every candidate and fill in the scorecard within 24 hours. Never ask about age, family plans, religion or health.

Offers

Your people partner prepares offers. Do not share salary figures with candidates before the offer is approved.

title: Paid time off
summary: How much time off you get, how to book it and what happens to unused days.
body:
Full-time employees get 20 days of paid time off a year, rising to 25 days after five years. You can carry over up to 5 days into the next year.

Book time off in the HR system at least two weeks ahead for anything over three days. Your manager approves it.

title: Parental leave
summary: Sixteen weeks of fully paid leave for every new parent, by birth, adoption or foster placement.
body:
Every new parent gets 16 weeks of fully paid leave in the first year after a birth, adoption or foster placement. You can take it in up to three blocks.

You keep your benefits while on leave, and you can ease back in at 60% of your hours for four weeks at full pay.

title: Holidays
summary: Company holidays for 2027, floating holidays and the year-end shutdown.
body:
We observe 10 company holidays in the US and the local public holidays in the Netherlands. You also get two floating holidays to use for days that matter to you.

All offices close between December 24 and January 1.

title: Health, dental and vision benefits
summary: Your plan options for 2027, what Meridian pays and how open enrollment works.
body:
Meridian pays 90% of the premium for employees and 75% for dependents on the Base plan. For 2027 there is also a Meridian Plus plan with a lower deductible.

Open enrollment runs October 12 to 30. See the 2027 benefits guide in the resource library.

title: 401(k) and retirement
summary: How the 401(k) match works and when it vests.
body:
Meridian matches 100% of your 401(k) contributions up to 5% of your salary. The match vests immediately.

In the Netherlands, you are enrolled in the industry pension fund.

title: Learning budget
summary: $1,500 a year for courses, books, conferences and certifications.
body: Every employee has $1,500 a year to spend on learning: courses, books, conferences or certifications. Agree it with your manager and expense it.

title: Compensation review process
summary: For people managers: the 2027 pay review timeline, budgets and how to talk about pay.
body:
This guide is for people managers. The 2027 pay review runs from November 9 to December 4.

  1. Finance shares your team's budget on November 9.
  2. Submit recommendations in the HR system by November 20.
  3. Calibration with your VP the week of November 23.
  4. Talk to each person about their outcome before December 18.

title: Code of conduct
summary: How we treat each other, our customers and the communities we serve. Every employee acknowledges it once a year.
body:
We act with honesty, respect and care for safety. We do not tolerate harassment, discrimination or retaliation of any kind.

Speaking up

If you see something wrong, tell your manager, your people partner or use the anonymous hotline. We will never punish anyone for raising a concern in good faith.

Gifts and conflicts

Do not accept gifts worth more than $75 from customers or suppliers. Tell your manager about any potential conflict of interest.

title: Health and safety at the plant
summary: PPE, visitor rules and how to stop the line. Read this before any visit to Tulsa.
body:
Everyone on the plant floor wears safety glasses, steel-toe shoes and hearing protection in marked zones. Visitors are escorted at all times.

Stop the line

Anyone can stop the line if something looks unsafe. You will never be blamed for stopping it.

title: Acceptable use of IT systems
summary: What you can and cannot do with company laptops, accounts and data.
body:
Company laptops and accounts are for work, with reasonable personal use. Do not install software that is not in the software catalog, and never share your password or passkey.

Report a lost or stolen device to the service desk within an hour.

title: Data classification and handling
summary: Public, internal, confidential and restricted data, and where each may be stored.
body:
All company data falls into one of four classes: public, internal, confidential and restricted. Customer meter data is restricted and stays in Meridian Cloud.

  • Public: anything on our website.
  • Internal: most of what is on this hub.
  • Confidential: contracts, pay, plans.
  • Restricted: customer data and credentials.

title: Travel and expenses
summary: Booking travel, what you can expense and how the new expense tool works.
body:
Book flights and hotels through the travel portal. Economy class for flights under six hours.

From November 2, submit expenses in the new expense app within 30 days, with a photo of the receipt. Meals are covered up to $75 a day when traveling.
